blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lone ticket holder won the P26.91 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot on Thursday, Nov. 19, 2026, draw, while no bettor won the P120.56 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The winning combination for Lotto 6/42 was 15-40-08-34-23-10, which secured the P26.91 million jackpot for one ticket holder. Meanwhile, the Super Lotto 6/49 draw produced the combination 23-24-10-02-09-37. No ticket matched all six numbers, leaving the P120.56 million jackpot without a winner.
